title: Thai Frittata
description: A Thai-inspired breakfast twist on the Italian classic frittata.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Whisk eggs and sour cream together in a bowl.
Add curry paste and whisk until combined.
Heat a 9-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender.
Pour egg mixture over peppers and cook until edges start to set.
Sprinkle cilantro and Tuscan seasoning over eggs.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
